notes: Historical data (revenue, operating income used as EBIT, total depreciation/amortization, and total capital expenditures) are taken from Allegion’s FY2025 Form 10-K; FY2023 balance-sheet line items for NWC are supported by the FY2024 Form 10-K. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1579241/000157924126000007/alle-20251231.htm))
EBIT definition: modeled as GAAP operating income (operating income) from the consolidated income statement; not adjusted/‘non-GAAP’ operating income.

NWC construction (end-of-year): NWC = (Total current assets − Cash and cash equivalents) − (Total current liabilities − Short-term borrowings and current maturities of long-term debt). This strips financing-related items so NWC tracks operating working-capital intensity. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1579241/000157924126000007/alle-20251231.htm))

Tax rate: base-case tax_rate equals FY2025 effective tax rate of 0.162 as reported; future tax effects are not separately modeled (base-case assumes stability). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1579241/000157924126000007/alle-20251231.htm))

NOL balance: uses disclosed tax loss carryforward amounts (Ireland federal tax loss carryforwards + non-Ireland tax loss carryforwards) from FY2025 disclosures; may differ from a strictly defined ‘NOL in DCF’ measure depending on jurisdictional constraints and credit vs. loss characterization. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1579241/000157924126000007/alle-20251231.htm))

Terminal exit multiple (14.0x EV/EBITDA) and WACC (8.5%) are pipeline assumptions (not directly disclosed by the company). Peer comps use forward-looking estimates; ‘NTM’ here is approximated by MarketScreener’s 2026 column as the next-year proxy. ([marketscreener.com](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ASSA-ABLOY-AB-22363198/valuation/))

Investments: treated as non-operating investments in equity method affiliates plus other debt/equity securities shown within Other noncurrent assets; this is an approximation of the ‘investments’ adjustment used by the DCF pipeline. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1579241/000157924126000007/alle-20251231.htm))

catalysts: Sustained Americas non-residential demand and price realization driving revenue and margin follow-through into 2026-2027.
Execution against enterprise excellence/cost actions that sustain operating margin above the historical average.
Accretive capital deployment (buybacks and targeted acquisitions/divestitures) that improves per-share earnings power.
company_overview: Global security products and solutions provider with operating performance evaluated via Americas and International segments.
Business model combines mechanical and electronic security products with services/software offerings across commercial and residential end-markets.
2025 performance reflected enterprise growth and operating margin expansion alongside continued cash generation for reinvestment and shareholder returns.
current_context: FY2025: net revenues of $4,067.3 million (+7.8% reported; +4.1% organic) and operating income of $859.5 million with operating margin of 21.1%. ([allegion.com](https://www.allegion.com/content/dam/allegion-corp/migration/news/2026/Q4-FY%202025%20Allegion%20Earnings%20Call_Press%20Release_FINAL.pdf))

2026 outlook: management guided to full-year reported revenue growth of 5% to 7% (organic 2% to 4%) and adjusted EPS of $8.70 to $8.90. ([allegion.com](https://www.allegion.com/content/dam/allegion-corp/migration/news/2026/Q4-FY%202025%20Allegion%20Earnings%20Call_Press%20Release_FINAL.pdf))

Balance sheet/liquidity: ended 2025 with cash and cash equivalents of $356.2 million and total debt of $1,980.1 million. ([allegion.com](https://www.allegion.com/content/dam/allegion-corp/migration/news/2026/Q4-FY%202025%20Allegion%20Earnings%20Call_Press%20Release_FINAL.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base-case growth assumes a normalization of enterprise growth after FY2025 outperformance, consistent with 2026 guidance range.
Profitability outlook is anchored to modest, structurally supported EBIT margin expansion (pricing/productivity and mix), converging to a 2030 target EBIT margin.
Reinvestment discipline: capex intensity and depreciation as a % of sales held near historical levels to support growth without aggressive reinvestment assumptions.
Working-capital intensity modeled to remain controlled, with NWC as a % of sales gradually improving versus recent peak utilization.
Valuation cross-check uses forward EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA and P/E multiples from broadly comparable industrial/security and home hardware names.
key_risks: Macro-driven demand softness or prolonged volume weakness, especially in International markets with mixed conditions.
FX volatility and commodity/input inflation impacting realized pricing and cost structure.
Integration/acquisition execution risk and/or restructuring charges that temporarily depress operating margins.
Tax regime changes and uncertainty around effective tax rate could move after-tax cash flows and valuation.

presentation.subtitle: Allegion (ALLE): DCF Inputs + Peer Multiples
valuation_summary: DCF base case ties 2026-2030 growth rates to management’s 2026 outlook and a gradual step-down toward a sustainable long-run rate.
Terminal assumptions are kept economically consistent with an industrial/security hardware profile (terminal growth of 2.5% and exit multiple approach).
Peer multiples provide a sanity check that the implied valuation range is not extreme versus forward-looking market expectations.
